PRESERVED_CONSTRAINTS: No component was marked TESTED: this audit did not execute tests.
Graph imports and blast radius were used only as structural evidence.
No functional source, test, configuration, ledger, or documentation file was modified.
No F2.6 run was performed; preflight reports it due and that fact is not converted into a passing/failing component claim.
config/governance.json remains outside agent mutation authority.
Secret values are not recorded in this artifact.
NEW_EVIDENCE: Fresh graph at sealed commit reported 3,290 bitemporal nodes, 8,855 import edges and current commit match.
Additional trunk queries established structural consumers for MemorySystem and Sandbox and broad ColdUpdate/Hermes blast radius.
Reality preflight establishes live Merkle health, bwrap availability and local Hermes reachability, but browser degraded and ColdUpdate historical validation degraded.
Direct code review established explicit PASS-only KnowledgeBase admission, self-build propose-only constraint and API-to-InferenceHub direct bridge.
INVALIDATED_CLAIMS: All external effects are Merkle-audited is not demonstrated across optional logger, separate emergency log, direct API bridge and direct filesystem/subprocess bypass paths.
MCP trunk has no consumers is invalid: empty graph blast output conflicts with observed callable trunk service and should be treated as incomplete graph coverage.
Tests prove live provider/self-build readiness is invalid: test-specific preflight can assume success and no test was run in this audit.
AuthBroker means Atlas never reads plaintext secrets is too broad: the broker rejects plaintext persistence, while other bootstrap code parses .env values for process use.
NEW_UNKNOWNS: Which deployed entrypoints instantiate real HermesKanbanAdapter versus HermesMockAdapter.
Which product/API mutation routes emit Merkle records, if any, outside the explicitly separate OS EventStore.
Whether every direct subprocess path is independently Merkle-audited and capability-gated.
Whether current user-adopted MCP entries have complete admission receipts and live health beyond configured status.
Whether MissionRunner has a production scheduler wiring.
Whether all proposal-store corruption paths are surfaced operationally rather than silently ignored.

NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.side_a: Operating invariant says every external effect is Merkle-audited.
NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.side_b: API bridge design keeps its own EventStore, governance emergency log is separate, and some component audit calls are optional/best-effort.
NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.resolution: Do not claim one fully enforced audit authority without end-to-end evidence.

NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.side_a: Catalog is described as machine source for curated MCPs.
NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.side_b: User-adopted MCP config is a separate accepted authority merged at trunk creation.
NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.resolution: Model catalog and adopted config as two authority planes.

NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.side_b: Process bootstrap includes plaintext .env parsing into memory.
NEW_CONTRADICTIONS.resolution: Reference-only claim is correct only for AuthBroker persistence, not process-wide handling.
